notes: Sherwood v2 on Robinhood Chain (4663) for the existing $IMD token: no new token, pool, distributor, ETH funding or initialization call. One contract is deployed, src/SherwoodV2Launcher.sol:SherwoodV2Launcher. Its constructor mines onchain the first CREATE2 salt whose address carries the Uniswap v4 hook permission flags 0x20CC (beforeInitialize, beforeSwap, afterSwap, beforeSwapReturnDelta, afterSwapReturnDelta) in its low 14 bits, then deploys src/SherwoodV2.sol:SherwoodV2 at that address with CREATE2; about 10M gas in total, rehearsed on a fork in test/SherwoodV2LauncherFork.t.sol. The game address is launcher.hook() and the salt is launcher.salt(). Neither constructor calls another contract: the launcher only hashes and creates, and the hook only stores its arguments and checks its own address flags with the Hooks library, so the empty-chain rehearsal passes. The launcher's eight parameters are the hook's eight constructor parameters, in the same order, as plain types. In declaration order: poolManager (Uniswap v4 PoolManager on Robinhood Chain) 0x8366a39cc670b4001a1121b8f6a443a643e40951; token ($IMD) 0x5f7bb59365ce557c26dbcaa4ee9d39a4b95b7127; host ($PFWA) 0xa934ba4f59070149d37a93f8a002af79bae35563; hostHolderMin 100000000000000000000000, i.e. 100000 PFWA in wei, the holding that earns the holder bonus; dice (Dice Protocol entropy) 0xd8a0680e7699526b57140ed4eafdcc7219dc0a0c; diceProvider 0x8741b8a825644d9ef18faf2dab5e9b47b900f2b6; owner $owner (0x420944b441715e34dd672ae0eb4526a7ad7d1eef), stored as both owner and initial operator; genesis 1791835200, the unix time round 0 starts, with rounds rolling every 20 hours from it. The hook runs the Sherwood leaderboard game on one native-ETH/$IMD pool: every buy scores points and pays 5% of its ETH into the round's pot; moves are Buy, Steal, Robin Hood, Flip (Dice Protocol randomness) and Shield, with stacking charges. Each pot pays the top 3 40/20/10%, 8% to the King of the Hill (longest at #1), 10% buys back and burns $IMD through the existing ETH/$IMD 1% pool, 7% buys back and burns $PFWA through its holder pool, and 5% rolls over. Prizes are claimable for 7 days; anything unclaimed is swept into the live round's pot. After deployment the owner initializes the game pool against launcher.hook() and points the hook at the two buyback pools with setBuybackPool and setHostBuybackPool; the owner can later hand over with setOwner and setOperator. Those are owner actions outside this manifest.
